subtitle: Business software built around your workflow, with no mandatory monthly subscription

services.title: Lawn Care Business Manager
services.description: A web application built around how a lawn care or landscaping company actually runs: properties, recurring services, crew scheduling, job completion and invoicing in one place. One-time development, self-hosted, no mandatory monthly subscription.
deliverables: Customer and property records with full service history
Online estimate requests, quotes and follow-up tracking
Recurring service schedules and crew day sheets
Mobile-friendly interface for crews in the field
Invoicing, payment status and customer notifications
